Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — quick timepicker + sandbox access

Hi Ari —

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood Hosted API. I saw your self-serve signup for the evaluation sandbox and wanted to offer a short 30-minute walk-through tailored to your use case so you can validate latency and embeddings quality quickly.

If that works, pick a slot on my quick timepicker (two-minute flow): https://cal.redwood.ai/timepicker/connor/novacart — the page shows times in your local timezone.

Suggested agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick intro + goals for the eval
- 15m: run a few calls against your corpus (we'll provision sandbox tokens)
- 10m: next steps (capacity, pricing, Dedicated options)

Prework: if you can drop a short example prompt or dataset link (Drive) into this thread that helps me prepare. I’ll ask ops to provision the sandbox and share temporary credentials ahead of the call.

If you prefer, propose two windows and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai
